name: Immich
description: Photo and video backup for your phone with search, faces and albums (compose stack with Postgres, Valkey and an ML worker).

ru.description: Резервное копирование фото и видео с телефона: поиск, лица и альбомы (compose-стек с Postgres, Valkey и ML-воркером).

composeYaml:
services:
  immich-server:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:release
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - database
      - redis
    ports:
      - "2283:2283"
    environment:
      DB_HOSTNAME: database
      DB_USERNAME: immich
      DB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      DB_DATABASE_NAME: immich
      REDIS_HOSTNAME: redis
      TZ: ${TZ:-UTC}
    volumes:
      - upload:/data
  immich-machine-learning:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:release
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - model-cache:/cache
  redis:
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:8-bookworm
    restart: unless-stopped
  database:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.3.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: immich
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: immich
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
volumes:
  upload:
  model-cache:
  pgdata:

meta.about: Photo and video backup solution directly from your mobile phone (alternative to Google Photos).
